working_definition: Author type 'Tm9 neuron' (L3_38) of the Konstantinides et al. 2022 wandering L3 optic lobe atlas: medulla-class Tm9 neurons, not split into dorsal/ventral subtypes.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm9 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: The authors name a single unsplit Tm9 type; the immature Tm9 parent (defined from Konstantinides et al. 2022) is exact, with the Tm9a/Tm9b immature subtypes as children.
